def build_agent(sandbox):
    # Define beam parameters to stay within build zone and mass constraints
    x_center = 20.0  # Centered in the build zone x-range [12, 28]
    y_center = 7.5   # Centered in the build zone y-range [6.0, 8.5]
    beam_width = 5.0  # Maximum allowed width (5.0 m)
    beam_height = 0.1  # Minimum height to minimize mass
    area = beam_width * beam_height
    density = 0.005 / area  # Ensures total mass of 0.005 kg
    
    # Create the single beam
    beam = sandbox.add_beam(x_center, y_center, beam_width, beam_height, angle=0, density=density)
    
    # Anchor the beam at multiple points to ensure stability under varying gravity
    # The beam spans from x=17.5 to x=22.5 (center at 20.0, width 5.0)
    anchor_xs = [17.5, 18.75, 20.0, 21.25, 22.5]  # 5 evenly spaced anchor points along beam
    
    for x in anchor_xs:
        # Anchor to floor (y=0.0) and ceiling (y=9.0) at each x position
        sandbox.add_joint(beam, None, (x, 0.0), type='rigid')  # Floor anchor
        sandbox.add_joint(beam, None, (x, 9.0), type='rigid')  # Ceiling anchor
    
    return beam
